The '''Cloud Mountain cavern''' was a secret cavern that was constructed by the [[Tarasin]], under the surface of [[Cloud Mountain]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==History==
The cavern was built by the Tarasin over one hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and they used it to [[Prison/Legends|imprison]] the [[t'salak]], a dangerous creature that had attacked them. They put a series of obstacles inside it, to prevent anyone with malicious intent from freeing the creature.

During the Clone Wars, a group of workers from [[CreedCon Construction]] accidentally rediscovered the cavern while constructing a race course. The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] entered it and hoped to free the t'salak. She passed most of the obstacles, but could not pass the final one, which could only be achieved by a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] user who had not been tainted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].
